Priya / Jonas / Ellen — I reviewed OrientApps' initial redline pass and attached my annotated draft (MSA_Redline_KP_comments.docx). Key items for the intake call and for OrientApps to prepare: 

- Data Processing & Security: I'll need to see the SOC 2 report link and confirm whether they require in-contract DPA language (we can map to our standard Exhibit D).
- Liability & Cap: Their redline proposes a full carve-out for data incidents; we'll propose the standard token-based cap and an exception ladder for gross negligence.
- IP/Output: Clarify whether OrientApps expects assignment of outputs; we'll keep standard Redwood ownership + limited license for customer data/product.
- Subprocessors: Provide a list of subprocessors and whether any are in EU.

Please have OrientApps confirm: signatory (with title), billing owner, and SOC2 link before the Wed call. If they can't provide SOC2, flag as a security escalation and we'll route to Compliance.

On timing: I can provide a redline back to Ellen by Thu 29 May EOD if we get the SOC2 and the final party sheet.

-Kim

Redwood Inference
